title: galium jordanii subsp. gracilentum
intro: Galium jordanii subsp. gracilentum, commonly known as the Jordan's bedstraw, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, helping to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Galium jordanii subsp. gracilentum include its emmenagogic properties, which help regulate menstrual cycles, and its expectorant properties, which aid in relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
